TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a delivery profile that aligns with the Provincial Health Department’s requirement for an integrated, multi-site HMIS program: we have completed multiple Hospital IT deployments, including provincial government delivery completed in 2023 and an international hospital IT deployment completed in 2022 [CAP-018][CAP-030]. This hospital domain experience is complemented by large-scale enterprise implementation capability (ERP programs up to PKR 188M, completed 2024) that is directly relevant to pharmacy/inventory, billing, and cross-site master data governance required in an HMIS rollout [CAP-038].

We differentiate on delivery assurance and governance. We are SECP incorporated, registered with FBR and on Active Taxpayer List, and maintain ISO 27001 for information security and ISO 9001 for quality management—critical for protecting patient data and controlling change across four tertiary-care hospitals [CO-PROFILE]. Our delivery is led by PMP-certified project managers (6 on staff), supporting the structured planning, stakeholder management, and risk control expected on a program of this size [CO-PROFILE]. Financially, we operate at scale (average annual turnover PKR 900M) and can arrange required bid securities through scheduled bank facilities [CO-PROFILE].

Where the RFP is explicit, we are transparent: our library does not yet evidence a valid CMMI Level 5 appraisal (we currently hold CMMI Level 3) [CO-PROFILE]. We will address this mandatory requirement through an eligible prime/consortium arrangement while remaining accountable for delivery outcomes.

In practical terms, you gain:
- Proven hospital IT delivery plus enterprise-grade implementation depth [CAP-018][CAP-030][CAP-038]
- Security-first operations under ISO 27001 and disciplined QMS under ISO 9001 [CO-PROFILE]
- Governed execution under PMP leadership and strong financial capacity for a PKR 320M program [CO-PROFILE]
